decisions.reason: Photo incorporation is independently established by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE; the layout approach, pass count, and coverage add no further change.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY changing the org-chart action to incorporation into the final draft; the source layout changes require no additional update.
Use of GreenLatinos colors and fonts is already captured by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE and is not further changed by the layout approach or pass count.
Table incorporation is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the full-document layout changes do not alter the table requirement further.
The print-ready PDF deliverable is independently and completely captured by its same-message INTRODUCE.
The straightforward layout option and single layout pass do not modify the previously stated page-count target.
Applying graphic treatment to the entire final draft does not change the requirement to include all supplied narrative content.
